We're recruiting on behalf of a highly successful and well-established business based in Kettering.

They're ambitious, growing and commercially successful, but they've managed to maintain a supportive, down-to-earth culture where people work together and enjoy what they do.

The business is well run.

This isn't a traditional EA role supporting one individual.

This is a role at the heart of the business.

You'll provide executive support to the Managing Director and a wider Leadership Team of Directors, acting as the person who keeps everything organised, coordinated and running smoothly.

You'll manage busy diaries.

Coordinate meetings.

Arrange UK and international travel.

Support company events and conferences.

And become the trusted point of contact for senior stakeholders across the organisation.

No two days will look the same.

One minute you could be coordinating overseas travel and visas.

The next you'll be preparing information for a board meeting or organising a major company event.

If you're someone who loves being organised, enjoys working with senior people and gains satisfaction from making things happen behind the scenes, this is the kind of role you'll thrive in.

- Managing complex diaries and meeting schedules
- Coordinating leadership, sales and company-wide meetings
- Organising UK and international travel arrangements and visas
- Managing expenses for senior leaders

- Supporting office management and ensuring smooth day-to-day operations

We're looking for someone who is naturally organised, highly professional and enjoys operating in a fast-paced environment and has experience providing executive support for multiple Leaders.

The type of person who spots problems before they happen.

The type of person who loves a well-managed diary.

The type of person who gets genuine satisfaction from keeping everything running smoothly.

You'll probably be someone who:
- Has previous Executive Assistant or Senior PA experience
- Is comfortable supporting multiple senior stakeholders
- Can prioritise competing demands without becoming flustered
- Has exceptional organisational skills
- Communicates confidently with people at all levels
- Takes ownership and uses initiative
- Pays close attention to detail
- Remains calm under pressure
- Enjoys building relationships across a business
- Loves being the person others rely on

This role won't suit someone who likes to sit back and wait for instructions.

We need someone proactive.

Someone who thinks ahead.

Someone who enjoys being one step in front of everyone else.

What's On Offer:
- Competitive salary
- Pension scheme
- Company benefits package
- Free onsite parking
- A varied and highly visible role
- The opportunity to work closely with senior decision makers
- A supportive and collaborative culture
- Long-term stability with a successful and growing business
- The chance to become a genuine business partner to the leadership team

Why This Role Is Different:

Lots of EA roles talk about working closely with leadership.

This one actually does.

You'll be involved in everything from strategic meetings and international travel to major events and company-wide initiatives.

You'll see how the business operates.

You'll work alongside senior leaders every day.

And you'll play a key role in helping them perform at their best.

For the right person, it's a fantastic opportunity to become one of the most important support functions within the organisation.

This is much more than a traditional sales admin position.

The role has been created from scratch, meaning you'll have the opportunity to put your own stamp on it, improve processes and take ownership rather than simply following the same routine every day.

The business is well established but continues to grow, offering the successful candidate the chance to develop alongside the company and build a long-term career.

You do not need to be an accounts professional. We're primarily looking for a strong Sales Administrator with Sage experience, a confident telephone manner and the right attitude.

What's on offer?

This is a temporary-to-permanent opportunity, initially joining on a temporary basis for approximately 3 months, with the intention of moving into a permanent position following a successful placement and mutual suitability.

- 28 days' annual leave.

- Private healthcare.
- Long-term career development opportunities.
- The chance to help shape a brand-new position.
- A varied role with genuine responsibility and scope to develop.
- A supportive, close-knit working environment.
- The opportunity to build a long-term career within an established and growing manufacturing business.

The person we're looking for

If you're a good Sales Administrator who enjoys speaking to customers, supporting sales and being proactive, we'd like to hear from you.

We're not looking for someone who needs to tick every box. More importantly, we're looking for someone with the right attitude, commercial mindset and willingness to get involved.

If you're looking for your next move and want a role where you can make an impact, develop your skills and grow with a business, this could be the opportunity for you.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
We are recruiting for an organised and efficient Project Coordinator to join an established team in Banbury on a full time, permanent basis - Monday to Friday. You will play a pivotal role in coordinating project admin tasks throughout the inception, planning and execution of new products coming to market. This role involves working with a multitude of internal and external stakeholders and requires a high level of organisation. You must have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, and the ability to work with all levels of the organisation. The ability to multitask is a must, as one minute you could be at your desk, the next minute you could be collecting samples from the warehouse.

As Project Coordinator, you will be responsible for:
- Overseeing the implementation of new product implementation
- Supporting team members during periods of high activity to ensure deadlines are met
- Requesting, chasing and reporting on samples as required, during the product development process
- Organising the weekly airfreight shipment and manage the prioritisation of samples as they arrive
- Liaising with Account Manager/Product Development Manager or Customer to implement
- Liaising with internal and external stakeholders on any delays to product or photography samples
- Aiding in packing, re-boxing, and transport of samples to where they need to be in the business for a given time
- Using the company CRM to manage new product set up including the completion of all administration and accurate, timely in-put of all necessary data, e.g., product specifications, product technical data sheets, quotes, packing and label specs, etc.
- Creating spec sheets and label specifications for new products, ensuring their accuracy and distribute to far-east suppliers
- Signing off all new products as complete and correctly setting up on system before first purchase order placed
- Maintaining all costing schedules and ensuring correct completion of all new product costing sheets from factory quote sheets
- Filing all factory quote sheets
- Liaising with other departments on a timely basis and ensuring communication from the dept. is accurate and effective. These are to include marketing, design, trading, technical, far-east teams and customer stakeholders
- Reviewing and signing off on new stock as it arrives
- Maintaining ongoing range management data and product queries

As Project Coordinator, you must be/have:
- Experience of working within an admin, coordinator position
- Experience of working within a product industry is preferred
- Confident approach to learning
- Good numeracy & literacy skills
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, and Outlook)
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Exceptional organisation skills - time management, ability to prioritise & meet project deadlines
- Forward thinker, able to identify and minimise problems before they occur
- Experience of following critical paths and timelines
- Self-motivated and positive attitude to self-development
- Full and valid UK driving licence due to some travel to other local sites

What's in it for me?

The salary for this role is competitive, holiday entitlement is 29 days' holiday during each holiday year, which includes the usual 8 public holidays. Holiday entitlement increases alongside length of service up to a maximum of 34 days. Additional benefits include employee discount on company products, auto-enrolment pension scheme, free onsite parking, learning and development opportunities, access to employee benefits platform including discounts and offers on hundreds of retail and leisure activities, online learning courses and Employee Assistance Programme (EAP).
